fusions.name: Snatched From Afar
fusions.desc: Reels out a lash at a target up to 6 tiles away that is at or below 25% health, dealing 22 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.2 times their remaining damage to this blow.

fusions.name: Hairspring Kick
fusions.desc: Springs you to a target up to 5 tiles away and kicks it for 14 damage, knocking it back 3.5 tiles and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Coiled Release
fusions.desc: Springs you 3 tiles from where you stood, then increases your movement speed by 25% for 6 seconds, with +10% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Ripple Skipper
fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank you move 10% faster, from silver you attack 6% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.
